# Training-loop boundaries and scale

Ideas for input-related work at evaluation, epoch and checkpoint boundaries, and for scaling once data delivery is sufficient. Preserve the training and evaluation recipe when changing how this work is scheduled. A rank is one participating training process; each rank may have several loader workers. Keep per-rank work separate from work that every rank must perform together.

Choose the topic whose symptoms match the measured bottleneck. Open only that reference for technique entries and their recipe, recovery and coordination guards.

[Catalog index](../technique_catalog.md)

## Evaluation boundary work

- [Evaluation boundary work](loop_boundaries_scale/evaluation_boundary_work.md): duplicated validation, serial inference input/output, whole-video memory growth and fixed epoch-boundary costs.

## Loader checkpoint progress

- [Loader checkpoint progress](loop_boundaries_scale/loader_checkpoint_progress.md): per-step state snapshots, cached payload serialization, mismatched resume cursors and device-resident CPU control counters.

## Rank coordination and scale

- [Rank coordination and scale](loop_boundaries_scale/rank_coordination_and_scaling.md): rank-0 side-work stalls, diagnostic waits, redundant control synchronization or setup and inefficient GPU allocation.

Investigate input and model hypotheses independently or concurrently; this scale family is not an instruction to exhaust input ideas before model work. Short, warmed cached-input model measurements must use native training and retain distributed communication. They screen execution changes, not E2E cost or quality. Promotion still requires matched-parent full-run speed validation and original-baseline quality checks.
